description: $0.02 per call. Use to judge a new pump.fun token by its creator's earlier launches: n_launches, resolved, graduations (curve witnessed >= 84 SOL), rugs by drain or dev dump, median seconds to the dev's first sell, the last 25 launches with outcomes, the creator's live mints and whether the wallet was funded in the last 30 min (warm launch); only outcomes known at request time count. Input: address (base58 wallet). A wallet we never saw launch answers is_first_time=true. For the launch itself use check_pumpfun_risk or mint_risk_card. A stale feed is refused before payment.
name: creator_reputation
title: Creator (dev wallet) reputation ($0.02)
